scope: All six needs-deeper-source records revisited using complete pinned file trees plus selected algorithm/readme sections. Nine full files archived and verified against pinned Git blob IDs. Not a full repository audit or upstream runtime qualification. Original 500 records remain historical and unchanged.

records.finding: files.rs:299-366,513-580 implements size buckets, streamed 8KiB hashes, then byte comparison to split hash collisions. Hash/read errors are silently omitted or mapped to false; no cancellation or immutable snapshot check in these functions. Retain the funnel/byte-proof principle already present in rrrah, not these error semantics.

FinderService.cs:119-138 hashes JPEG after EXIF removal with MD5, and 395-429 treats matching hashes as content matches without byte confirmation. Therefore its SameContents class does not prove original byte identity. Loop cancellation is outside ComputeHash. Keep per-file error isolation as a reference; do not adopt equivalence or cancellation behavior.

Pinned SCFDS entrypoint loads ItemNewPath using OpenItemScript. ReadItems.cpp parses game-style item type/subtype, level, serial and attributes, rather than image/file content descriptors. These inspected modules offer no evidence of a relevant image matcher.
README and ClassifyService identify Stack Overflow question duplicate ranking using BM25, cosines and classifiers over question pairs. Text/question retrieval falls outside this file/image library.

PerceptualHash.java is a concrete image pHash: 32x32 grayscale resize, full 32x32 2D DCT, top-left 8x8 excluding DC, median threshold producing 63 bits. Four nested DCT loops compute unused frequencies; no source alpha/HDR policy or original-pixel identity proof is established. rrrah already has independently specified perceptual hashing; do not substitute this for equality.

The complete pinned tree contains the sample and build files but no non-sample algorithm source. README advertises a separate Maven artifact. The library algorithm is not auditable from this repository revision; sample usage and percentage claims do not establish its correctness.
